summary: Validated the Scouting share-metrics + leaderboard + Open Graph card-page feature end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases PASS (POST /track download/share/invalid/404/persistence; GET /share-ranking items/order/exclude-zero; GET /public/{sid}/card no-auth PNG for post & story + 404 unknown + 404 when share disabled; GET /public/{sid}/card-page OG meta present + og:image points to /public/{sid}/card + twitter:card=summary_large_image + human UA increments views + facebookexternalhit UA does NOT increment). Frontend: Login OK; Panel de Control (dashboard) renders <shared-talents-board> widget with 1 row; Scouting → pestaña Ranking also renders the same board (rows include downloads/shares/views/total). Share dialog contains all 16 required data-testids. card-link-input value is /api/recruiting/public/{sid}/card-page?format=post&b=... Track integration verified: social-card-post-btn fires POST /track {action:'download'} (downloads 1→2), share-whatsapp-btn fires {action:'share'} (shares 2→3), card-link-copy-btn fires {action:'share'} (shares 3→4). Reopening the share dialog reflects the updated share_stats.
critical_code_review_comments: recruiting.py L816-824 track_prospect_share: whitelist ('download','share') + 404 handling correct. _bump_stat uses $inc on share_stats.{key} which creates the sub-document if absent. Good.

recruiting.py L827-852 share-ranking: filters rows with total>0 OR views>0. Note: the docstring/spec says 'Solo incluye prospectos con actividad (>0)' — currently a prospect with only views>0 (0 downloads/0 shares) IS included with total=0. This matches 'actividad' liberally. If the intent is total>0 only, tighten the filter. Not blocking.

recruiting.py L898-957 public_card_page: _BOT_UA list includes 'bot','crawler','spider','preview' — will also block e.g. Googlebot as intended. Views correctly gated behind is_bot check. og:image url uses base override (b) when provided, essential for the Kubernetes ingress pattern.

recruiting.py _abs_url upgrades http→https for non-localhost hosts (good), but if x-forwarded-proto reports 'http' behind an SSL-terminating LB the initial branch will honor it. In practice x-forwarded-proto=https on this preview so OK.
ScoutingModule.js copyCardLink counts a click as 'share' (per spec). Toast confirmation shown as check icon swap. Verified integration.

ScoutingModule.js SharedTalentsBoard loads via useEffect on mount only — if the dashboard is kept open and stats change elsewhere, the widget won't refresh until re-mount. Non-blocking but worth noting for future polish (e.g. focus-based revalidation).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all requested testids + track integrations
